lines.t: I pulled in hungry, just past dawn,
Neon lightin’ up where the night had gone,
YahuShua smiled with a plate in His hand,
Said, “Child, eat what I provide, and you’ll understand.”
At Heaven’s Hashbrowns , sittin’ booth thirteen,
He’s servin’ up truth with a side of serene,
Can’t stay awake if you don’t take a bite,
So I’m feasting on grace ‘til the morning light.
He poured me joy from a coffee pot,
Said, “Abide in Me—forget what you’re not.”
Every crumb on this table’s a sign,
Of bread from Heaven and love divine.
At the Heaven’s Hashbrowns, sittin’ booth thirteen,
He’s servin’ up truth with a side of serene,
Can’t stay awake if you don’t take a bite,
So I’m feasting on grace ‘til the morning light.
Now I ain’t the same since that first sip,
Mercy on tap, peace on His lips,
One who is woken can’t stay that way,
Without His supper served fresh each day.
At the Heaven’s Hashbrowns, my heart’s set free,
A soul on fire with good company,
He said, “Abide in Me and never fade,”
At the counter of truth, I’ll always stay.
